column1: # Custom liver-cancer signatures not in MSigDB. One row per gene; lines starting with # are ignored.
# Fill from the papers' supplementary tables (never from memory). Set names are referenced in
# config/subtype_signatures.yaml as "custom:<set>". Direction "dn" rows become set "custom:<set>_DN".
#   Gao et al., Cell 2019 (Tables S3, S5, S7; scripts/tools/extract_gao2019_signatures.py): GAO2019_* sets.
#     Proteomic subgroups 1/2/3 are NOT in these tables (expected in Table S1/S2, not yet provided).
#   Zhu et al., Nat Med 2022 (Supplementary Table 2; scripts/tools/extract_zhu2022_signatures.py): ZHU2022_ABRS
#     (10-gene response signature) and ZHU2022_ATEZOBEV_RESPONDER_UP (187 genes). Teff / Treg / myeloid /
#     angiogenesis signatures are in the paper's Methods, not the supplement: still to add.
#   Pinyol et al., J Hepatol 2021: supplement has no new gene list (it scores published signatures, Table S15:
#     Hoshida, Chiang, Sia, Villanueva, Moffitt, Yoshihara, hallmarks). Nothing to extract.
#   Desert et al., Hepatology 2017 - already in MSigDB (DESERT_*_HEPATOCELLULAR_CARCINOMA_SUBCLASS_UP).
#   TCGA Cell 2017 iClusters - per-sample labels in the TCGA PanCan clinical file (SUBTYPE column); use as an annotation.
#     HABER2023_IFNAP (11), HABER2023_S6_* (46 published sets from Haber Table S6: Bindea immune cells,
#     POPLAR Teff, Sangro, cytolytic activity, Ayers IFN, TLS, IMPRES, MDSC, WNT/TGFb, ICI-resistance sets).
#   Gao 2019 Table S2 (mmc2) is copy-number data, not the proteomic subgroups (those need Table S1).
#   Zhu 2022 Teff / Treg / myeloid / angiogenesis (main-text Methods); Moffitt 2015 activated stroma
#   (Sia's Active vs Exhausted split); Gao 2019 proteomic subgroups (Table S1).
